ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 2:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity (black) pigmentation region originating from the peduncle and extending vertically, bifurcating into a broad 'Y' shape toward the trailing edges. High-intensity (white) fields on lateral lobes contain scattered punctate black mottling and stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; a notable irregular macro-indentation is present on the distal tip of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a convex curve from the median notch toward the distal tips, which terminate in sharp, posterior-pointing hooks.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark punctate pixel clusters (scars) are visible across the high-intensity white fields, with a higher concentration on the distal margins of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity linear markings (rake marks) are visible traversing the white ventral surface of the left lobe, oriented roughly horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged tissue loss/notch on the distal tip of the left lobe; multiple parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in the central black pigmentation, with the black region extending significantly further toward the trailing edge on the right lobe compared to the left.
